title: Stranger Worlds
description: A group of teens unlocks portals to dimension-twisting adventures while trying to find their missing friend.

description: An undercover hacker races against time to prevent an energy grid collapse in a neon-soaked megacity.

description: Two musicians fall in love as they collaborate on a cross-world composition spanning alternate timelines.

description: Astronauts stranded on a rogue space station uncover a mutiny as a meteor storm rushes toward them.

title: Code Meridian
description: An elite developer confronts her past while leading a team to build a sentient climate-defense AI.

title: Sonic Bloom
description: A family band discovers harmonics that heal ecosystems as they tour a dystopian countryside.
